welcome: Welcome to our neighborhood! Choose a community helper.
choose-helper: Pick a helper to earn a Community Hero badge.
drag-help: Drag or tap the right tool.
nudge: That tool helps someone else. Try another.
firefighter-intro: Firefighters help keep people safe. Let's find their tools!
firefighter-hose-prompt: Drag the hose to the firefighter.
firefighter-hose-success: Yes! The hose carries water to help put out fires.
firefighter-helmet-success: Right! The helmet helps protect the firefighter.
firefighter-bio: Firefighters train, work as a team, and help in emergencies. Thank you, firefighter!
doctor-intro: Doctors help people feel better. Let's find their tools!
doctor-stethoscope-prompt: Drag the stethoscope to the doctor.
doctor-stethoscope-success: Yes! A stethoscope helps a doctor listen to a heartbeat.
doctor-first-aid-success: Right! A first-aid kit holds supplies to care for small hurts.
doctor-bio: Doctors listen, ask questions, and care for people who are sick or hurt. Thank you, doctor!
teacher-intro: Teachers help us learn and wonder. Let's find their tools!
teacher-book-prompt: Drag the book to the teacher.
teacher-book-success: Yes! Teachers share stories and ideas with books.
teacher-pencils-success: Right! Pencils help learners draw, write, and wonder.
teacher-bio: Teachers help us practice, explore, and grow. Thank you, teacher!
mail-carrier-intro: Mail carriers bring messages to our neighborhood. Let's find their tools!
mail-carrier-mailbag-prompt: Drag the mailbag to the mail carrier.
mail-carrier-mailbag-success: Yes! A mailbag keeps letters safe along the route.
mail-carrier-letters-prompt: Now find the bundle of letters.
mail-carrier-letters-success: Right! Mail carriers bring letters to homes and neighbors.
mail-carrier-bio: Mail carriers sort and deliver letters and packages in every kind of weather. Thank you, mail carrier!
badge-earned: You earned a Community Hero badge!
album: Here are the helper badges you've earned.
all-complete: You met every helper! Our community shines when people help each other.
